llm_text: I still lean towards disagreeing that NAFTA has been good for the US. While the idea of free trade is appealing and can lower consumer costs by accessing necessary resources, the reality seems to be that it has led to significant job losses and a weakened domestic manufacturing base, which ultimately harms the country more. The concentration of economic benefits in corporations, rather than broader societal gains, also makes it a questionable success.
